about: Catalog for the APPS workspace (Zzz5-W9). Versions, sizes and SHA-256 come from each item's own manifest, never from this file. An item without a manifest that carries sha256 is listed but never offered for download.

apps.name: Verso app (Android)
apps.info: Verso as an Android app. Carries Verso Keyboard and Verso Voice Reader inside.

apps.name: Verso Keyboard
apps.info: Android keyboard - works in other apps too. Turn it on once in Android keyboard settings.

apps.name: Verso Pass Keyboard
apps.info: Password keyboard - part of Verso Keyboard, not a separate install.

apps.name: Verso Voice Reader
apps.info: Reads text aloud, offline. Never reads codes, passwords or PINs.

apps.name: Slovak voice (lili)
apps.info: Voice for Verso Voice Reader. Downloaded and checked inside the Reader.
